title: DiffuTester: Accelerating Unit Test Generation for Diffusion LLMs via Mining Structural Pattern
review_status: full-text audit complete; main efficiency/coverage tables, repository sample, syntax-quality checks, transfer tasks, and limitations checked
sections_checked: Sections 5.1-5.4 repository evaluation and task transfer
Appendix C.2.5 syntax quality versus speed
venue_year_verified: arXiv v4 dated 2026-09-12; venue not independently checked
evidence_note: Two 7B dLLMs evaluated; up to 2-3x speedups at similar line coverage, including 135 buildable single-function Tests4Py instances. Reports line coverage/syntax/pass@1, but not the share of generated Tests4Py tests that reproduce each known bug. This is an endpoint boundary, not a negative result.

title: Test Case Generation from Bug Reports via Large Language Models: A Cognitive Layered Evaluation Framework
review_status: full-text audit complete; benchmark and BRT definition, mutation results, open-book comparison, benchmark caveats, and executed-layer scope checked
venue_year_verified: arXiv v1 dated 2025-10-06; venue metadata in manuscript not independently adjudicated
evidence_note: Defines BRT as compiling, failing on buggy version, and passing on fixed version. Baseline GPT-4o BRT is 36.5% on Defects4J and 32.3% on GHRB; identifier masking reduces rates, while open-book examples help in some settings. Flags potential training overlap, 47 of 812 Defects4J reports lacking relevant information, and 66 bugs grouped under 29 reports. Case study executes four of six proposed layers.
